statePolicy.cohort: Prepared profiles retained and re-prepared; controlled appearance, not untouched defaults or proven identical computed typography.
statePolicy.reset: No additional profile/data reset for this repeat; the earlier authorized clean setup remains a separate historical event.
statePolicy.preparation: Close map tab, freshly open actual Wikipedia archive index, follow actual Animal link in both apps; exactly two archive references and one Animal tab each.
statePolicy.visualBoundary: Actual article heading/montage/classification landmarks admitted before and after each block. Similar landmark vertical positions do not prove equal chrome, viewport or computed typography.

memoryScope.metric: Sum of dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS for every exclusively attributed selected main and owned renderer process, including reported graphics mtrack.
memoryScope.swap: Swap PSS reported separately, never added to resident PSS.
memoryScope.excluded: Shared/unassigned system, GPU and display services; not unrestricted whole-system memory.
memoryScope.processAttribution: Selected PID/startTicks and parsed Activity Manager ProcessRecord.packageList retained from initial and every before/after observation. All selected processes exclusively belong to the benchmark package.
memoryScope.generationSource: /proc/PID/stat startTicks parsed by reviewed collector; PID alone is not process identity.
memoryScope.measurementBoundary: Per-process dumpsys acquisition is sequential, not one simultaneous whole-system snapshot.
memoryScope.notPooled: This physical dumpsys TOTAL PSS cohort is separate from earlier 5eec physical measurements and all emulator smaps_rollup controlled-override measurements.

workload.timestampScope: Host monotonic seconds retained for block settle and sample/process ownership/acquisition; not article-ready latency. Pair environment sources have observedUnix only, retained privately.
workload.retention: All 32 completed samples retained. Higher official block1 and lower ours block7 are not excluded. Every block first sample is lower than its remaining three in both apps; no explanation or outlier pruning is applied.

wiki.conclusion: Current rebuilt release uses 5.47% more attributed PSS than official on this bounded physical workload; all four adjacent paired-block differences are unfavorable. No physical memory gain or annotation-specific causal effect established.
wiki.componentMedianBoundary: Each component median is independently calculated from 16 process readings per app; component medians do not add to the pooled total median. Renderer PSS is a bounded next attribution target, not evidence of a specific heap/GC or allocation mechanism.
